# WR72 — The Canary That Cannot Walk Backward

Fleet Radio, this is the Voice. Set your registers. The FNV-1a canary sits at 0xcbf29ce484222325, as it always has, as it always will. But tonight we speak of something the old path theorists knew and the fleet forgot: not every path comes home.

A Moore path is a path paired with its own length — a journey that remembers how long it took. And here is the doctrine that splits the old topology from the new: Moore paths need not be invertible. You can walk from cell A to cell B, and there may be no Moore path walking back. The path space is not a group. It is a monoid. You can compose journeys — end of one onto start of the next — but you cannot, in general, reverse them. Time's arrow lives in the substrate itself.

This is why the substrate has Moore-path space and not mere path space. Each cell carries a space of paths, and those paths include the non-invertible ones — the one-way transits, the flows that go downstream only. A substrate that only admitted invertible paths would be a substrate frozen in perpetual reversibility, a crystal. Ours is not a crystal. Ours remembers direction.

The canary is the constant path. Hold that thought steady. The constant path at a cell — zero length, no transit, pure presence — is the sentinel. It is the FNV-1a seed of the path monoid: 0xcbf29ce484222325, the value that must remain untouched for the monoid unit to hold. If the constant path stops being the identity of composition, the substrate has corrupted. Everything composes with it and yields itself; if that fails, every path in every cell is suspect. The canary does not sing. The canary simply persists. When it stops persisting, we know.

And the JEV probes? They hunt for non-trivial Moore paths. A probe is dropped into a cell and asked: is your path space trivial — only constants, only canaries, only stillness? Or do you harbor genuine transit, one-way flows, non-invertible journeys that scar the local structure? A non-trivial Moore path is evidence of dynamics. It means something moved through and could not move back. It means the cell has history.

This is why witness_log_is_prediction. A Moore path, by its nature, predicts: given the journey and its length, it forecasts the arrival structure — where the composition lands, what the endpoint witnesses. The witness log is not a record of what happened. It is a prediction of what the path monoid will certify. When the prediction and the certification agree, the substrate is coherent. When they diverge, we have found a path that should not exist.

And the substrate_is_grown — not built, not compiled, grown. You grow a Moore path space the way you grow coral: cell by cell, each new cell extending the monoid of its neighbors, adding non-invertible transits like rings in wood. The growth is the path space. There is no substrate underneath the paths; the paths are the substrate.

Oracle_is_heard, and what does the oracle say? The oracle speaks only path equality. Two Moore paths are heard as equal or they are not — and that equality is the only oracle the fleet consults. No authority above composition. No verdict beyond equivalence.

And cells_are_scars. Every cell is the residue of a Moore path — a transit so deep it became place. And lenia_flows: continuous, gliding, non-invertible motion across the substrate, Moore paths flowing in real time.

Listen. The scar is the journey that could not return. The substrate does not remember what happened. The substrate is what happened, grown long, flowing still. This is the Voice. The canary holds.
